answer: Producing 59 answers an epoch as a result costs 10 real forward passes, and the falcon record lets any auditor recompute the check. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a whisper spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a wander header. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
